finish: The finish line (2026-11-11): Notch island Phase 5, the website, your hand tests, then one pass of the Small fixes list. Everything else is parked.

items.name: Hand-test what has merged
items.line: These merged with only automatic checks and need you at the Mac. Main chat M1, required before it counts as done: run risky commands in Auto (deleting, pushing, installing) and see the card still ask and say why. Notch island 2 and 3: the note, a failed build, a long message, the eyes following the cursor, the panel at the side. Notch island 4 (about 5 minutes): with the Glass look, watch Steward in the notch over a light and a dark wallpaper and look for the fine edge on a light bar; turn Reduce Transparency on in the Mac's settings and see the notch go flat; wake the notch with your real cursor in Only when needed; with Reduce Motion on, wake and sleep the notch quickly and check it never looks half awake; watch Steward join a big island for any stall. Main chat M3 (about 5 minutes, on the real desktop): open a chat with your API key and watch the home fold into the one status line (working, waiting, images). Make something wait and click the amber count. Press New chat and see the cards come back. Try Reduce Motion, light and dark, and the notch and a moved panel. Look at whether a waiting session plus the API key note leave the thread too little room. Visual Review 1b to 3: a real turn, the big viewer's keys, a phone-width page. Visual Review 4 (about 3 minutes, steps in Feature building's report): turn on Hold the session for my review, ask for a visible change in the Claude desktop app, and look at the session while Steward's card counts down (does it look running, is there a stop button?). Send a note back and see whether Claude acts on it and how the note looks in the transcript. Type a message during a wait. Run claude /login first for the terminal, since its login has expired. Steward's moods (R1, R2): an hour of idle. Overnight Watch 1 to 3: a real night. Movable panel and notch 3b from before. Tell the front door what feels off; small things go on the Small fixes list.

items.name: Website: record the walkthrough video (30 to 45 minutes)

items.name: Steward dozes when idle
items.line: The reactions brief said the face dozes after 5 and 10 quiet minutes. It does not: at rest it is Resting right away and Sleepy only after midnight. A real dozing face (heavy lids at 5 minutes, asleep at 10, any event wakes it with a blink) would be its own small change.
